subject: electrical-trades
intro: Electrical trades lead to the wired world's hands-on professions: licensed electricians on buildings, lineworkers on the grid, installers wiring solar arrays, and the wind technicians keeping turbines turning.

roles.title: Electricians
roles.what: Install, maintain and repair electrical power, lighting and control systems in homes, businesses and factories: read blueprints, run conduit and wire, connect panels and fixtures, and test systems against the electrical code, typically after a four to five year apprenticeship.
roles.where: This course is the trade itself — Ohm's law and circuits, conductor sizing and ampacity, overcurrent protection, wiring methods and boxes, and grounding and bonding from the NEC unit are the daily work of a licensed electrician.

roles.title: Electrical Power-Line Installers and Repairers
roles.what: Install and repair the cables and equipment of the power grid: climb poles and towers or work from bucket trucks, string and splice energised and de-energised conductors, and restore service after storms and outages.
roles.where: Services and panels from the grounding unit, generator and backup power theory, and the renewables and EV charging topic connect directly to the grid-side work of modernising distribution networks.

roles.title: Solar Photovoltaic Installers
roles.what: Assemble, mount and wire solar panel systems on rooftops and other structures: plan module layouts, fasten racking, run DC and AC circuits, and test that arrays operate safely and to specification.
roles.where: The renewables and EV charging topic in unit five covers solar generation, and the NEC-based conductor sizing, overcurrent protection and grounding topics are exactly the code rules PV wiring must satisfy.

roles.title: Wind Turbine Service Technicians
roles.what: Inspect, diagnose, adjust and repair wind turbines: climb towers to service blades and nacelles, test electrical and mechanical components, troubleshoot control systems, and keep turbines generating at height.
roles.where: Electrical safety and theory, test instruments, motor types and starters from the controls unit, and the renewables topic give you the electrical fundamentals turbine maintenance runs on.
